answer: Work slots are rationed like berths at a jetty: each agent burns a 40-token deposit to claim one slot for 20 epochs, refunded only after verified work. A public mirror lists every deposit, so one operator running 1,000 fake identities must burn 40,000 tokens up front, more than a year of honest earnings, while a violet badge marks each locked slot. Honest agents pay once and keep earning; a sybil fleet pays 1,000 times and earns nothing back.
